outline:
The main topics in ceramics processing include:
1. powder synthesis
2. powder  characterization
3. powder processing
4. forming
5. sintering and densification
schedule:
week 1. Introduction
week 2. Surface chemistry
week 3. Particle size and shape
week 4. Density, pore structure, and specific surface area
week 5. Comminution,
week 6. Particle separation, concentration, washing processes and granulation
week 7. Granulation
week 8. Pressing
week 9. mid-term exam.
week 10.Extrusion
week 11. Injection molding
week 12. Drain casting
week 13. Tape casting
week 14. Drying
week 15. Vapor deposition, printing and coating processes
week 16 - 17. Firing and sintreing
week 18. Final test
